fusions.name: Lazy Slap
fusions.desc: A slow slap that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gentle Nudge
fusions.desc: A nudge of water that deals 12 damage and pushes the target back 2 tiles. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Slow Current
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 18 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Ease
fusions.desc: When your health is full, you regain 2 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
